name: dsh-ide-workbench
description: JetBrains-style Project, Commit, Terminal and Git tool windows around an embedded editor, with chat file links, send-to-chat @references, a Git repository picker that leaves the file tree alone, a file-locate button, a faster session switch and code intelligence: local completion everywhere, plus semantic completion, go to definition and find usages when a language server is available.
author: LiangshouX
